score: inverse average-rank percentile of rounded income proxy among eligible, complete-coverage Amsterdam cells; ties equal; lower income = higher score
grid_transfer: exact polygon overlap in EPSG:3035; area-weighted mean of published neighbourhood medians; NOT a cell median or household estimate
publication: income scenario enabled for Amsterdam only
missing_policy: null values; no zero substitution, no parent-area imputation, no name-based matching
missing_reason: source non-publication confirmed by raw marker; individual cause not inferred
boundary_policy: exact code join candidate; spatial boundaries must be checked before grid transfer
comparability: Brussels equivalence scale, coverage and household/person weighting remain unresolved
boundary_source: site CBS 2025 neighbourhood polygons, export_web_data.py layer amsterdam_neighbourhoods_2025
coverage_rule: minimum 99.9% of clipped cell area; within 0.1% is a geometric tolerance, not income imputation; partial values remain unscored
neighbourhood_summary: area-weighted mean of eligible cell scores, only if >=99.9% of eligible-cell overlap area has income scenario scores; direct source median also shown separately
brussels: no comparable neighbourhood income integrated; no income scenario score
